author: jochembrouwer
content:
RE: gas cap, I will let Maria weigh in but you could indeed be correct that this is the constraint. We can calculate how much bytes are read at most (theoretical max) which is `(block_gas_limit // COLD_ACCOUNT_ACCESS) * MAX_CODE_SIZE`, which for 200 Mgas is (for Glamsterdam) `4166.625` MiB (`~4.069 GiB`)

I am getting confused by https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7870
If `Random 4K Read IOPS: At least ~50,000` isn't this off by a lot? Isn't this `(4096 * 50_000) / (1024 * 1024)` is 195 MiB/s?
Also this: `Sequential R/W: At least ~500 MB/s`

Am I missing something here? 🤔  Note that also with current max size (which is `3/8` of Glamsterdam) this then still looks problematic
